fehler.nicht_erreichbar: The DMS cannot be reached. Check the address, whether the DMS is running and whether Homey can reach it on your home network.
fehler.zertifikat: Homey does not trust the certificate of the DMS (for example self-signed or expired). Use an address with a valid certificate or, on your own home network only, the http address of the DMS, e.g. http://192.0.2.10:8080.
fehler.schluessel_ungueltig: The API key is invalid, deleted or expired. In the DMS, create a new key with the level "nur Zähler" (counts only) under Profil > Sicherheit > API-Schlüssel and enter it here.
fehler.falsche_stufe: This API key has the wrong level. Use a key with the level "nur Zähler" (counts only), in the DMS under Profil > Sicherheit > API-Schlüssel.
fehler.wartung: The DMS is in maintenance mode. Homey will ask again after the next polling interval.
fehler.kein_dms: No DMS version 0.148.0 or newer answers at this address. Check the address (e.g. https://dms.home.arpa) and the version of your DMS.
fehler.umleitung: The address redirects. Enter the target address directly, e.g. https:// instead of http://.
fehler.adresse_ungueltig: Enter the address of the DMS with http:// or https://, e.g. https://dms.home.arpa.
fehler.schluessel_format: This is not an API key of the DMS. It starts with dms_ and is only fully visible right after you create it.
fehler.unerwartet: Unexpected answer from the DMS. Details are in the app log.

hinweis.stufe_lesen: Tip: a key with the level "nur Zähler" (counts only) is enough and reveals less if it gets lost.
